witness.branch: Electric bicycle overtakes a motor vehicle
witness.quote: Overtake and pass a motor vehicle
witness.reason: The one-way multilane layout supports constructing a pass of a motor vehicle traveling ahead.
required_context: Construct lane geometry, passing side and relative motion covering approach, alongside travel and clearance ahead.
Establish qualifying wheels, operable pedals, saddle, motor output no more than 750 watts, assistance only while pedaling and cessation at 20 miles per hour; exclude mopeds and electric scooters.

Identify ego's Class 1 electric bicycle with qualifying wheels, operable pedals, saddle, motor no more than 750 watts, assistance only while pedaling and ceasing at 20 miles per hour; exclude a moped or electric scooter.
Identify the other vehicle as the overtaken statutory motor vehicle and establish actual occupant count.
Identify the overtaken statutory motor vehicle, actual occupant count and occupant identities.
Retain physical circumstances relevant to both the operator and motor-vehicle occupants without inventing safety, clearance, closing-speed or time-to-conflict cutoffs.
Specify lane geometry, passing side and relative motion from approach behind through alongside travel and clearance ahead.
witness.subject_reason: The selected party operates a qualifying electric bicycle and is the overtaking participant.
